subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat ship the full long-press action menu requested here, or only a narrower copy/select capability?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the requested Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply bundle changes Android chat interaction policy and has a conflicting open implementation candidate rather than a strict bug-fix lane.

options.title: Sponsor a focused action menu
options.body: Review or replace the open linked PR with a focused Android chat action menu that includes the maintainer-approved action set and real device or emulator proof.

options.title: Narrow to copy/select only
options.body: Keep the issue open but constrain the fix to message text copy/selection, leaving Share and Reply for separate product requests.

options.title: Defer Android message actions
options.body: Leave the current code-block-only selection behavior in place until Android chat UX work is reprioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a focused action menu
recommendation.body: Review or replace the open linked PR with a focused Android chat action menu that includes the maintainer-approved action set and real device or emulator proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current issue assignee and appears in recent Android chat UI history as a co-author/adjacent contributor.
